audit.title: HOP Adversarial Audit Sample
audit.scope: Representative technical, business, and operating evidence

publication.redaction_policy: Remove confidential evidence before creating any public companion report.

source_quality.rationale: A material durable-acceptance boundary remains open.

validation_coverage.rationale: Source checks passed, while physical radio evidence remains unavailable.

business_readiness.rationale: Pricing semantics are not yet reconciled across product surfaces.

process_quality.rationale: The audit preserves independent review and explicit evidence limits.

operational_readiness.rationale: No production or physical-hardware evidence was authorized.

executive_summary.assessment: Evidence <must> survive escaping, and source confidence must remain separate from live readiness.

strengths.claim: The wire version is explicit and has a deterministic corpus.
Every inventoried component has a final coverage disposition.

lean_in.why_now: Acceptance semantics define the product reliability claim.
lean_in.next_control: Bind acknowledgement to atomic durable state advancement.

lean_in.why_now: A buyer cannot evaluate an inconsistent billable event.
lean_in.next_control: Choose one metering contract and reconcile every surface.

coverage.rationale: Physical Apple hardware was unavailable; static source coverage is represented elsewhere.

findings.title: Acceptance can precede durable state advancement
findings.invariant: A message is accepted only after authenticated durable state advances atomically.
findings.threat_model: A local crash or store fault occurs between acknowledgement and state persistence.
findings.impact: The sender can observe success while restart loses accepted state.
findings.business_impact: The managed delivery guarantee remains unprovable.
findings.scenario: A receiver authenticates a message, acknowledges it, then crashes before the ratchet and inbox transaction commits.
findings.root_cause: Acknowledgement is not transactionally bound to every durable state mutation.

evidence.detail: The acknowledgement path and durable mutation have separate failure boundaries.
The suite covers success but does not inject failure between each write.

findings.coverage_gap: No restart regression injects a fault between every durable write.
findings.remediation_boundary: Commit message, replay state, and ratchet state atomically before acknowledgement.
closure_contract: Inject a fault at every durable write boundary.
Prove restart cannot roll back an accepted message.
Run the hostile regression against every supported durable store.

findings.title: The billable event differs across commercial surfaces
findings.invariant: Public pricing, billing enforcement, forecasts, and sales material define the same billable event.
findings.threat_model: A buyer, operator, or billing service interprets delivery units differently.
findings.impact: Invoices, forecasts, and customer expectations can diverge.
findings.business_impact: Sales cannot offer a precise or defensible commercial contract.
findings.scenario: The site quotes delivered messages while an internal model counts ingress submissions and retries.
findings.root_cause: No owner-approved canonical metering contract exists.

evidence.detail: Internal pricing notes use multiple metering terms.
The public calculator uses delivered-message language.

findings.coverage_gap: No approved catalog-to-invoice reconciliation fixture exists.
findings.remediation_boundary: Choose one canonical billable event and encode it in copy, catalog, service, forecast, and contract fixtures.
closure_contract: Reconcile all public and internal pricing surfaces.
Exercise a catalog-to-invoice fixture with retries and failed delivery.
residual: Blocked on a founder decision about the canonical billable event.

refuted_candidates.title: Wire version is implicit
refuted_candidates.hypothesis: Peers cannot reject an unsupported wire layout before decoding it.
refuted_candidates.disproof: The bundle prefix carries the explicit version and deterministic vectors bind the current value.

limits.text: No live cloud, registry, customer, financial, legal, or physical-hardware evidence was authorized.

operational_actions.text: Run the physical radio matrix when representative hardware is available.
